1-3.title: Respiratory tract, skin and vision
1-3.prompt: Have you or any member had respiratory tract, skin, eye, nose or throat diseases, or refractive vision defects?

4-5.title: Cardiovascular and vascular diseases
4-5.prompt: Have you or any member had cardiovascular or vascular diseases, including strokes or brain hemorrhages?

6-11-12-13-22.title: Nervous, endocrine and immune systems and related history
6-11-12-13-22.prompt: Have you or any member had nervous system, endocrine, immune or sexually transmitted diseases, or donated or received blood transfusions?

7-8.title: Digestive system, kidneys and urinary tract
7-8.prompt: Have you or any member had digestive, kidney or urinary tract diseases?

9.title: Musculoskeletal diseases
9.prompt: Have you or any member had a musculoskeletal disease?

10.title: Cancer or tumors
10.prompt: Have you or any member had cancer or any type of tumor?

14-15.title: Women's health and obstetric history
14-15.prompt: Does any included woman have or has she had gynecological conditions, is she pregnant, or has she had pregnancies or miscarriages?

16.title: Men's health
16.prompt: Does any included man have or has he had prostate disorders, phimosis, paraphimosis or urinary retention?

17.title: Sports activity
17.prompt: Do you or any member practice a sport?

18.title: Congenital or hereditary diseases
18.prompt: Do you or any member have a congenital or hereditary disease, physical defect or developmental disorder?

19-23.title: Surgeries and interventions
19-23.prompt: Have you or any member undergone surgery or planned a surgical intervention or medical treatment?

20.title: Psychobiological habits
20.prompt: Do you or any member use or have used nicotine, alcoholic beverages or addictive drugs?

21.title: Current medical treatment
21.prompt: Are you or any member currently undergoing treatment with medication?

24.title: Family history
24.prompt: Do you or any member have a family history of relevant diseases?

25-26.title: Health contract history
25-26.prompt: Do you hold a health contract with another company, or has one ever been denied or cancelled?

1.title: Respiratory tract diseases
1.description: Allergies, asthma, bronchitis, pneumonia, frequent cough, snoring, tuberculosis, covid-19, pulmonary fibrosis, etc.

2.title: Skin, eye, nose or throat diseases
2.description: Deviated nasal septum, tonsillitis, rhinitis, sinusitis, recurrent otitis, cataracts, skin disorders, psoriasis, eczema, warts, vitiligo.

4.title: Cardiovascular diseases
4.description: High blood pressure, heart attack, coronary or heart failure, arteriosclerosis, rheumatic fever, valvular insufficiencies, thrombophlebitis, deep vein thrombosis, varicose veins, pericarditis.

6.title: Nervous system diseases
6.description: Seizures, epilepsy, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, dizziness, autism.

7.title: Digestive diseases
7.description: Stomach diseases, esophagus, gastritis, peptic ulcer, digestive hemorrhages, irritable colon, pancreatitis, cholecystitis, hemorrhoids, gallstones, umbilical, inguinal or epigastric hernias.

8.title: Kidney or urinary tract diseases
8.description: Recurrent urinary tract infections and kidney stones, hematuria (blood in urine), prostate.

9.title: Musculoskeletal diseases
9.description: Arthritis, gout, herniated discs, back pain, spinal injuries or deviations.

10.title: Cancer or tumors
10.description: Brain, thyroid, lung, breast, liver, pancreas, stomach, ovaries, uterus, cervix, prostate, leukemia, lymphoma.

11.title: Endocrine system diseases
11.description: Diabetes, thyroid, goiter, pituitary, cholesterol and triglyceride disorders.

12.title: Immunological pathologies
12.description: Lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, scleroderma, antiphospholipid syndrome, thyroiditis, hemolytic anemia, dermatomyositis.

13.title: Sexually transmitted diseases
13.description: Syphilis, gonorrhea, chlamydia, HIV/AIDS, genital herpes, HPV.

14.title: Female
14.description: Breast disorders, pelvic pain, uterus, fallopian tube and ovary conditions, incontinence, fibroma.

15.title: Pregnancy / Obstetric History
15.description: Is any of the women included in this request pregnant or has she had abortions?
15.extraInputLabel: Indicate number of pregnancies / Weeks / Abortions
15.extraInputPlaceholder: Ex: 2 full-term pregnancies, 0 abortions, currently not pregnant

16.title: Male
16.description: Prostate disorders, phimosis or paraphimosis, urinary retention.

17.title: Sports Practice
17.description: Do you or any person included practice any sport?

18.title: Congenital or Hereditary Diseases
18.description: Do you or any of the applicants suffer from any congenital or hereditary disease, physical defect, anomaly, developmental disorder, mental disorders, down syndrome?
18.extraInputLabel: Indicate name, last name of the affected person and condition
18.extraInputPlaceholder: Ex: Name and last name of the affected person and description

19.title: Previous Surgeries
19.description: Have you or any person included undergone any surgery? (Functional or Aesthetic).

20.title: Psychobiological Habits
20.description: Do you or any of the people included use or have used tobacco products, alcoholic beverages or addictive drugs?
20.extraInputLabel: Indicate products and quantity per day/week
20.extraInputPlaceholder: Ex: Tobacco 5 cigarettes/day, occasional social alcohol

21.title: Current Medical Treatment
21.description: Are you or any other person included in the contract currently undergoing treatment with any medication?

22.title: Blood Transfusions
22.description: Have you or any other person included in the contract donated or received blood transfusions?
22.extraInputPlaceholder: Ex: Received due to surgery in 2019

23.title: Planned Interventions or Treatments
23.description: Are you or any other person included in the contract scheduled for any surgical intervention or medical treatment?
23.extraInputLabel: Specify planned procedure and estimated date

24.title: Family History
24.description: Do you or any other person included in the contract have family history of diabetes, hypertension, heart or kidney disorders, cancer or congenital or hereditary disease, tuberculosis, mental illness or suicide?
24.extraInputPlaceholder: Ex: Father with Hypertension, Mother with Type 2 Diabetes

25.title: Active health contracts with another company
25.description: Do you or any family member maintain an active health contract with another company?

26.title: Denial or annulment of health contract
26.description: Have you ever been denied or had a health contract annulled?
